$comment: The docs site's pages. A page under site/content/ is written for the site and cites the repository docs it summarises: its See also links them on GitHub, and scripts/sync-docs.mjs checks that each link names a file and heading that exist. The generated references (orkctl, configuration, error reasons, API, changelog) are ported from the repository as they are.

pages.title: OrkStack documentation
pages.description: What OrkStack is, and where to go next: a first run, a task to get done, or a key to look up.

pages.title: Your first Orkflow
pages.description: Clone OrkStack, start it with Docker, and apply, run and inspect an Orkflow, in about ten minutes.

pages.title: Examples

pages.title: Take inputs and return outputs

pages.title: Add retries and timeouts

pages.title: Run a task conditionally
